solid-body rotation.notes: A undefined: no strain to align with; h = 0 and D = 1/2 (Thales 'fully degenerate')

pure extensional strain.notes: A undefined: no vorticity to stretch; h = 0 and D = 1/2, IDENTICAL to solid rotation although the states are physically opposite

simple shear.notes: sits exactly at the Thales apex (maximal 'coherence' h = 1/2) with zero enstrophy production: the apex is not a production landmark

Lamb-Oseen (unstretched).notes: zeta varies with r and t (>0 in the core, <0 in the outer shear region); P = 0 and A = 0 everywhere, so the vortex only diffuses

Burgers vortex (axis).notes: A = sqrt(2/3) exactly (bound saturated); zeta independent of a; P = a|omega|^2 grows as a^3 at fixed similarity radius
